Grad Overview
Funding
Graduate Funding
Funding is available throughout the lifecycle of your degree program. Many U of A Engineering graduate students are supported by teaching or research assistantships that pay tuition and a stipend, plus there are a number of fellowship and scholarship opportunities through the University and partner organizations.
Among the many sources of graduate school funding are the following:
NSF Graduate Research Fellowships: Highly competitive three-year fellowships up to $120,000 for STEM
National Defense Science and Engineering Graduate Fellowships: $93,000 over three years, plus all tuition and fees
GEM Fellowship Program: $16,000 a year plus additional stipends and tuition (for underrepresented minority students)
Graduate funding programs for everyone: a number of funding options
Visit the College of Engineering's Funding Opportunities list for up-to-date fellowship and scholarship announcements.
CONTACT: msgradadvisor@ecse.arizona.edu or phdgradadvisor@ecse.arizona.edu
